answer: Reaching eligibility takes 64 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The crystal register is checked at draw time, sparrow lists the eligible set, and raven seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 64 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The deposit is 70 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
